Universe...

text_block_list.text:

a claw machine filled with plushies themed 
after Umamusume.

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:

this... "heart throbbing"?

text_block_list.text:

the ‘trajectory’ to obtain it...”

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"I want the plushie, but I don't know how 
to win it..." Is that what they're trying 
to say?
